title: WF03 OIDC-03 focused test blockers: fake env return-type coercion mismatch and bootstrap standalone idp_config import dependency
summary: Resolved two OIDC-03 focused unit-test blockers in identity provider config/bootstrap code paths: a return-type coercion mismatch in FakeEnv.getAlloc and a standalone test import dependency on the idp_config module alias. Added a test-only fallback shim when the root module alias is absent, while preserving normal module import behavior.

root_cause.details: src/config/identity_provider.zig returned allocator.dupe directly from FakeEnv.getAlloc, which did not coerce to the declared anyerror!?[]const u8 in focused zig test mode. src/identity/provider/bootstrap.zig imported idp_config via module alias only, which is unavailable in standalone zig test execution for that file.

changes: In src/config/identity_provider.zig FakeEnv.getAlloc now dupes with try and returns an explicit ?[]const u8 coercion.
In src/identity/provider/bootstrap.zig idp_config now resolves from root.idp_config when present, with a test-only local fallback shim for standalone zig test contexts.
In src/identity/provider/bootstrap.zig TC-OIDC-03-05 now uses env:PATH for deterministic keycloak secret resolution in focused test mode.

prevention: For standalone zig test targets, avoid depending solely on build module aliases; provide explicit local test fallbacks when alias wiring is unavailable.
When function signatures include optional/error-union/const combinations, use explicit coercion in test doubles to prevent focused compile-type mismatches.
